c9a05493-0b9c-416e-8913-e45410699b62.label: Structural Carbohydrates and Lignin in Biomass
c9a05493-0b9c-416e-8913-e45410699b62.desc: Determination of structural carbohydrates and lignin in extractives-free biomass by two-step sulfuric acid hydrolysis (NREL/TP-510-42618). Action-based layout with automated calculations.

fields.label: Procedure Details
fields.default: Weigh 300 ± 10 mg of extractives-free biomass sample to the nearest 0.1 mg. Add 3.00 ± 0.01 mL of 72% sulfuric acid and stir at 30 ± 3 °C for 60 ± 5 min (primary hydrolysis). Dilute with DI water to 4% acid concentration (total volume 84 mL). Add sugar recovery standards (SRS) to designated samples. Autoclave at 121 °C for 60 min (secondary hydrolysis), then cool to room temperature. Vacuum filter through a pre-weighed filtering crucible, wash the residue with ≥50 mL DI water, and collect the filtrate in a volumetric flask. Measure UV absorbance of the filtrate at 240 nm for acid-soluble lignin. Neutralize an aliquot with CaCO₃ to pH 5–6, filter through 0.2 µm, and analyze by HPLC for sugars (Aminex HPX-87P) and acetic acid (HPX-87H). Dry the crucible with residue at 105 ± 3 °C to constant weight to determine acid-insoluble residue, then ash at 575 ± 25 °C for 24 ± 6 h. Acid-insoluble lignin = residue weight minus ash weight. Calculate corrected sugar concentrations using SRS recovery and anhydro correction factors, and report all components as % oven dry weight.

Autoclave at 121 °C for 60 min (secondary hydrolysis), then cool to room temperature. Vacuum filter through a pre-weighed filtering crucible, wash the residue with ≥50 mL DI water, and collect the filtrate in a volumetric flask. Measure UV absorbance of the filtrate at 240 nm for acid-soluble lignin. Dry the crucible with residue at 105 ± 3 °C to constant weight to determine acid-insoluble residue, then ash at 575 ± 25 °C for 24 ± 6 h. Acid-insoluble lignin = residue weight minus ash weight. Calculate corrected sugar concentrations using SRS recovery and anhydro correction factors, and report all components as % oven dry weight.
